name: Water and sand barrels
description: Barrels lashed by every hatch. Fires are put out 75% faster.

name: Sharp axes
description: Keen edges at every rail. Grapple ropes are cut 75% more easily.

name: French cook
description: Proper food from the galley, and nobody asks what's in it. Morale drops 30% more slowly.

name: Navy training
description: A gun captain who learned his drill on a ship of the line. Reload 15% faster.

name: Disgruntled sniper
description: He hates everyone, them most of all. Sits in the rigging in battle picking off their hands, now and then one of their specialists.

name: Peg legs
description: A sawbones with a stack of timber legs. A specialist cut down in battle has a 50% chance to be patched up and stay in service (once each per fight).

name: Experienced whaler
description: An old Nantucket hand with a harpoon. 20% chance each day at sea to bring in whale oil, whalebone or even ambergris, to sell at any port or outpost.

name: Fine-corned powder
description: Powder milled fine and dry. Every round or heated shot that strikes the hull does 1 more damage.

name: Crazy scientist
description: A natural philosopher with singed eyebrows and a box of 'improvements'. Round shot that hits has a 15% chance to explode: +3 hull damage, fire, and anyone nearby is hurt.
